remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated corner unit apartment located in the highly sought-after Candlelight Terrace complex! Enjoy an updated kitchen, brand-new flooring, and tons of natural light throughout. Step out onto your private porch overlooking the river-perfect for morning coffee or evening relaxation.  This home also offers access to a sparkling pool, making it easy to unwind and enjoy warm summer days. With river views, modern updates, and a prime location just minutes from top restaurants, shopping, parks, and public transportation, this apartment truly has it all.  Don't miss out on this rare gem in one of Stamford's best communities!
